# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- This reflection reverses the sign of only one pion field, so the relative phase is defined with an additional π compared with refs. [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is constructed by flipping the sign of all three pion fields.
- The convention adopted here allows a more natural comparison with the analogous monopole configuration.
- As stated in (3.10), the profile function vanishes at a distance s/2 from the centre of the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion), which lets the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion be joined continuously, with the fields taken to be the vacuum outside the core regions.
- Besides the initial conditions from the simple ansatz (3.7), more refined initial configurations were also implemented using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
